mapper.select: SELECT t.TRADE_ID tradeId,/**交易编号**/ null outTradeId, /*外部成交编号*/ deal.BOOKSET_ID prodId,/**金融产品代码**/ bok.BOOKSET_NAME prodName,/**金融产品名称**/ zc.FINPROD_MARKET_ID oAssetId,/**转出证券代码**/ zc.FINPROD_ABBR oAssetAbbr,/**转出证券代码**/ fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID cAssetId,/**转入证券代码**/ fp.FINPROD_ABBR cAssetAbbr,/**转入证券名称**/ t.PS ps,/**交易方向**/ t.TRADE_DATE tradeDate,/**交易日**/ t.SETTLE_DATE settdateDate,/**交割日期**/ t.INV_AIM invAim,/**会计分类**/ t.SHARE_AMT oTradeNum,/**转出证券数量**/ t.trade_amt oTradeAmt,/**转出证券金额**/ tfpb.SHARE_AMT cTradeNum,/**转入证券数量**/ tfpb.PRIN_AMT cTradeAmt,/**转入证券金额**/ t.CCY ccy,/**币种**/ CASE WHEN ttfd.FEE_TYPE = 'B06' THEN ttfd.FEE_AMT ELSE 0 END as tradeAmt,/**交易手续费**/ CASE WHEN ttfd.FEE_TYPE = 'B99' THEN ttfd.FEE_AMT ELSE 0 END as otherAmt,/**其他应付费用**/ stl.SETTLE_AMT settleAmt,/**结算金额**/ stl.MY_ACCT_NO acctNo/**资金账户**/ FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL t LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT zc on zc.finprod_id = t.finprod_id LEFT JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING deal on deal.BUSI_NO = t.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET bok on bok.BOOKSET_ID = deal.BOOKSET_ID LEFT JOIN STL_ORDERS stl ON stl.TRADE_ID = t.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_BARTER tfpb ON tfpb.TRADE_ID = t.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON tfpb.FINPROD_ID = fp.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL ttfd ON ttfd.TRADE_ID = t.TRADE_ID where t.BUSI_TYPE in('02','06','07') AND t.PS in('T49','T64','T63') and t.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId}

SELECT a.FINPROD_MARKET_ID id, a.FINPROD_MARKET_ID text, a.FINPROD_ABBR object FROM FIN_PRODUCT a inner join fin_product_type b on a.finprod_id=b.finprod_id where b.TYPE_1 = '028' OR b.TYPE_1 = '029'
AND (a.FINPROD_MARKET_ID like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')) OR a.FINPROD_ABBR like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')))
union all
SELECT a.FINPROD_MARKET_ID id, a.FINPROD_MARKET_ID text, a.FINPROD_ABBR object FROM FIN_PRODUCT a where 1=1 and FINPROD_TYPE = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F06,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND (a.FINPROD_MARKET_ID like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')) OR a.FINPROD_ABBR like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')))
